record.question: Admission record form is also known as:
options: The front sheet of the case sheet
record.explanation: Answer B: The front sheet of the case sheet. The admission record is the front sheet of a conventional paper case sheet and carries identifying/admission details. Reference: https://iris.who.int/bitstream/handle/10665/208125/9290610050_rev_eng.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
